title: Second Order Differential Operators on Graphs
summary: The commutator of a pair of vector fields on a graph is not a vector field in general, but rather a second order differential operator. We investigate this departure from the classical case of vectors fields on a manifold by examining the geometry of balls of radius two, concentrating on the set of paths of length two connecting a given vertex with the center of the ball. There is a natural surjection from the space of sections of the second tangent bundle to the space of second order differential operators whose kernel reflects the geometry of these balls.
